thread:
marina: Quick noteCustomers asking for formal 'pin' terms when we deprecate models. They want clear timelines, rollback steps, and assurances on migration support. Can product draft a short SOW checklist we can attach to deals?

devon: Eng-ML needs a benchmark spec before we commit. Minimum: p95 latency, token-cost delta, top-1 regression on their evals, and a factuality check on a customer prompt slice.

sana: Ops requirement: a runbook with automated reroute and documented fallback for pinned tenants. If ops can't simulate the rollback, we should not sign.

tyler: Sales note: two AEs want a six-month pin window; they will ask for credits if parity isn't met. We need a commercial exception template.

ev an: Cust-succ translation: "pin" => reserved access to old model, validated upgrade path, hard deprecation date, and rollback runbook.

devon: Implementing pinned instances requires capacity reservation and an autoscaler override; propose a pricing addendum and customer sandbox for validation.

marina: Proposed SOW checklist: Scope (model + version), Benchmarks (eval names + thresholds), Migration window (start/end), Ops (rollback steps + contacts), Pricing & credits, Escalation. Keep it short and attachable.

legal-bot: Warning: any absolute guarantees trigger indemnity/audit clauses. Use measurable gates and "reasonable efforts" language.

sana: Product owns SOW checklist, Eng-ML owns benchmark spec, Sales owns commercial template, Ops owns runbook.

tyler: I'll draft the commercial exception template and a one-liner for AEs to collect (sample prompts, SLOs, percent traffic).

devon: Quick benchmark spec to include in SOW:
```
- Eval suites: e.g., customer-prod-regress-2026, hallucination-smoke-2026
- Metrics: p50/p95 latency (ms), tokens/sec, relative token-cost (%), top-1 exact-match delta, hallucination-rate (annotated)
- Acceptance: <=5% relative top-1 degradation AND <=1% absolute increase in hallucination on the customer's critical prompt set
```
sana: Add hard gate: benchmarks pass + sandbox run (>=1M tokens) + ops drill (2 simulated failovers).

ev an: Also include comms cadence: 60/30/7 day notices, test traffic windows, rollback message templates, support POC list.

marina: Action items: sana -> SOW checklist by EOD Wed; devon -> benchmark spec doc; tyler -> commercial exception template; evan -> comms checklist. I'll compile and loop legal Thurs. Reconvene Fri for sign-off.

tyler: I'll offer temporary migration credits to the two customers and coordinate with AE. :+1:

legal-bot: Appendix should include: pinned instance termination (min 30d notice), emergency rollback SLA, liability limit for third-party regressions.

marina: If anyone wants additional fields (telemetry hooks, audit logs, data residency constraints), drop them here before Thurs.
